h1: Shi-ro-i Poshtel — A Clean Japanese-Style Poshtel in Central Hat Yai
intro: If you want a genuinely clean, budget place right in the centre of Hat Yai with a Japanese-style pod bed that feels private, Shi-ro-i Poshtel is a name reviews mention often and rate very highly. It's a small poshtel on Supasarnrangsan Road, offering both pod beds in dorms — each with a curtain and partition walls — and private Deluxe rooms for couples or families. Dorm beds start from approx. THB 360, while private rooms start from approx. THB 700/night. It scores 9.2 from 336 reviews and holds a Travelers' Choice award — its draw is cleanliness, friendly staff and a location within walking distance of the markets and food.

body.html: What sets Shi-ro-i Poshtel apart from typical budget stays in Hat Yai is its cleanliness and Japanese-style pod beds · each bed in the dorm has partition walls on both sides and a curtain for a door, so you sleep with the privacy of a little room of your own rather than on an open bunk like a usual hostel · many reviews praise how clean everything is, from the beds and walkways to the well-kept shared bathrooms · it's the main reason the overall score reaches 9.2.

Beyond the dorm beds there are several private rooms to choose from — a King-bed Deluxe, a family room sleeping four, and a Deluxe with an extra sofa bed · the private rooms are around 36 sqm, bright and clean, and suit couples or small families who want more privacy than a dorm while keeping costs down · they come with air conditioning, a fridge and a water filter, which reviews say is more than expected at this price.
"The best dorm I've ever stayed in. Everything is spotless, the pod beds have curtains and walls for privacy, the staff are lovely and helpful, and the location is super convenient."

Location is another strong point · the poshtel sits on Supasarnrangsan Road in the heart of Hat Yai, an easy few-minute walk to Kim Yong Market, Lee Garden, CentralFestival and the food streets · there's a 7-Eleven and restaurants nearby, making late-night food runs simple · it's close to Hat Yai railway station and the Chinatown area, handy for travellers arriving by train or coach who want to stay central.

Service is a theme reviews return to again and again · the staff are friendly and helpful, with several reviews singling out the reception team for kindness and good local tips on where to eat and go · there's a 24-hour front desk, a shared lounge and a small garden to relax in, a shared kitchen for reheating food, and laundry service · some rooms and pods even include small welcome touches like a toothbrush or a little gift that places at this price rarely provide, which makes the owner's care obvious.

There are trade-offs that come with the poshtel format · this is a small property with dorm-style facilities rather than a full hotel · some reviews note limited lift access and parking, so if you're driving, check with the property about parking first · dorm rooms use shared bathrooms, and being in the city centre means there's some street noise at times · if you need total quiet or full hotel amenities, this may not be the answer.

On price, dorm beds start around THB 360 a night, while private rooms start around THB 700 and rise to roughly THB 900–1,200 for a family room or a room with a sofa bed depending on the season · over long weekends and festivals, when Malaysian and Singaporean visitors pour into Hat Yai, rooms sell out fast and prices climb · a score of 9.2 from 336 reviews and a Travelers' Choice award show this is a budget stay that guests are unusually happy with.

In short, Shi-ro-i Poshtel suits travellers who want a clean, budget place in central Hat Yai and like the privacy of a Japanese-style pod bed · it works for solo travellers, budget-minded couples and small families who pick a private room · but if you want an en-suite bathroom in every room, easy parking, or full hotel facilities, compare it against the downtown Hat Yai hotels too.

A tip from the reviews: if you're two people or a family, a private room is better value and comfier than booking several dorm beds · if you're in the dorm and worried about noise, bring earplugs as it's right in the city centre · if you're driving, ask about parking before confirming · and book a Free Cancellation rate ahead over long weekends, as rooms fill fast.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Shi-ro-i Poshtel Hat Yai

faq.q: Where is Shi-ro-i Poshtel and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's at 228/42 Supasarnrangsan Road in Hat Yai, Songkhla, right in the city centre · about a 5-minute walk to Kim Yong Market, 7 minutes to Lee Garden, with Chinatown within walking distance · close to Hat Yai railway station (about 10 minutes by car) and Hat Yai Airport (HDY) about 20 minutes by car.

faq.q: What are the rates and room types at Shi-ro-i Poshtel?
faq.a: Dorm beds start around THB 360/night · a private Deluxe room from about THB 700 · a Deluxe with sofa bed around THB 950 · and a family room sleeping four from about THB 1,200 · prices depend on the season and rise quickly on long weekends, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: What are Shi-ro-i Poshtel's Japanese-style pod beds like?
faq.a: Each dorm bed has partition walls on both sides and a curtain for a door, so you sleep with the privacy of a little room of your own rather than on an open bunk like a usual hostel · reviews praise how clean and well-partitioned they are, ideal for solo travellers who want privacy on a budget.

faq.q: Who is Shi-ro-i Poshtel best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers who want a clean, budget place in central Hat Yai · great for solo travellers in the dorm, budget-minded couples and small families who pick a private room · if you want an en-suite in every room, easy parking, or full hotel facilities, also look at the city hotels.

faq.q: What should I know before booking Shi-ro-i Poshtel?
faq.a: It's a small property with dorm-style facilities and limited lift access and parking · dorm rooms use shared bathrooms, and the city-centre spot brings some street noise at times · if you're driving, check parking first, in a group a private room is better value, and book a Free Cancellation rate ahead over long weekends.

faq.q: What facilities does Shi-ro-i Poshtel have?
faq.a: There's a small garden, a shared lounge, a shared kitchen, laundry service and a 24-hour front desk · free Wi-Fi in all rooms, and private rooms have AC, a fridge and a water filter · some beds and rooms include small welcome touches rare at this price, a sign of the owner's care.
